issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.0.0 ViewDefinition.select.select contentReference and ViewDefinition.where definitions: nested select is recursive, where is 0..* with required path and optional string description.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe .temp/qa/sof_vd05_explorer_probe.py. Direct dataclass ViewDefinition(resource="Patient", select=[Select(column=[Column(path="id", name="id")], select=[Select(where=[{"notPath":"active"}])])]).to_dict() returned official JSON containing {"where":[{"notPath":"active"}]} instead of rejecting it. It also serialized nested where descriptions as null/non-string values. Parser and SQLGenerator validate the same shapes, so serializer can emit invalid recursive select JSON.
issues.root_cause: Select.to_dict() directly copied self.where dictionaries during official JSON serialization instead of using the shared validate_where_conditions() boundary already used by parser and SQLGenerator direct-input validation.
issues.resolution: Select.to_dict() now rejects where=None and normalizes non-empty where values through validate_where_conditions(), so recursive nested select serializers reject missing path and invalid/null description values. Added focused direct-dataclass nested select serializer regressions.
